title: Audit exact-snapshot frontier-pressure contract before dispatch
mission: Statically verify the exact-source frontier-pressure workflow and artifact contract before any workflow dispatch: source_sha must be propagated end-to-end, historical snapshots must not satisfy the exact run, failures must remain fail-closed, and the produced artifact must match prometeo.frontier-pressure-snapshot/v1. Patch only repository-local defects with bounded tests; do not dispatch Actions or infer runtime evidence.
definition_of_done: Inspect .github/workflows/frontier-pressure-exact-snapshot.yml and the exact scripts it invokes.
Prove from source that source_sha is carried into the regression/snapshot path and that mismatched or missing exact-source evidence fails closed.
Verify the artifact schema/name and the fields used for FRONTIER_THIN, RETURNS_UNCONSUMED and REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE.
If a repository-local defect is found, patch it with a bounded regression; otherwise record STATIC_CONTRACT_OK.
Return the exact remaining boundary as github_actions_workflow_dispatch_with_inputs; no historical run may be substituted.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion.
